purpose: Prioritize three San Agustin source labels whose reported Romblon locality conflicts with the independently documented geographic ranges reviewed.

method.scope: Focused range-and-authority triage of Pomatoschistus minutus, Strongylura marina and Tetraodon lineatus. This is not a complete 39-label range review.
method.distinction: GBIF name matches resolve name strings in its backbone; the cited taxonomic and regional references are used separately for geographic context.
method.evidenceLimit: A published range mismatch raises an identification question but does not prove absence, rule out an introduction, or identify the specimens.

candidates.gbifMatch: Exact accepted species-rank match; nomenclatural result only.
candidates.independentRange: The specialist Fishes of the Northeastern Atlantic and Mediterranean account gives the eastern Atlantic from Tromsø, Norway to Spain, plus the Mediterranean and Black Sea (distribution may be discontinuous).
candidates.philippinesEvidence: No Philippine-range source or specimen-level record was verified in this focused review.
candidates.conflict: The reported Romblon estuary/tributary locality lies far outside the cited European range.
candidates.action: Request the voucher/catalog number and diagnostic photographs; keep the source locality and label verbatim until reviewed.

candidates.gbifMatch: Exact accepted species-rank match; nomenclatural result only.
candidates.independentRange: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes lists the species as valid and gives the Western Atlantic, from Massachusetts south to southern Brazil.
candidates.philippinesEvidence: No Philippine-range source or specimen-level record was verified in this focused review.
candidates.conflict: The reported Romblon locality is outside the cited Western Atlantic range.
candidates.action: Request the voucher/catalog number and diagnostic photographs; check for confusion with a western-Pacific needlefish before any occurrence projection.

candidates.gbifMatch: Exact accepted species-rank match; nomenclatural result only.
candidates.independentRange: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes gives North and Central Africa and freshwater/brackish habitat.
candidates.philippinesEvidence: The 1999 BFAR Common and Local Names of Marine Fishes of the Philippines prints Tetraodon lineatus with the local name Coral butterfly in its regional name lists, including a Palawan entry. Its methods describe eliciting local names using illustrated forms with fishers and market vendors, plus information from institutions; this is not a specimen survey and supplies no voucher validation for the Romblon label.
candidates.conflict: The African range and freshwater ecology conflict strongly with a Romblon estuary/tributary identification, while the BFAR local-name record shows the name has also been used in Philippine fisheries reference material. Neither source establishes the identity of the surveyed specimens.
candidates.action: Treat as unresolved taxonomic/name-use conflict; seek the actual voucher and collection photographs before making a presence or nonnative claim.

nextAction: Later focused follow-ups add Scorpaena cardinalis, Periophthalmus barbarus and Schismatogobius risdawatiae, bringing the voucher-priority mismatch count to six; Tridentiger trigonocephalus is a separate range-authority discrepancy, not counted as an outlier. Other follow-ups check Philippine context for Belobranchus segura, Stiphodon atropurpureus and Rhynchorhamphus georgii and current names for Guiris margaritaceus and Carangoides talamparoides. Continue screening the remaining 19 labels and prioritize voucher follow-up; do not convert range mismatch or database nonmatch into a species absence claim. See the linked San Agustin range/name follow-ups, including mimaropa-san-agustin-range-authority-followup-20261105.json.

sources.supports: The 2025 survey's reported San Agustin, Romblon estuary and tributary study context and source taxon labels.
